content: where $\mathbf {x}_t \in \mathbb {R}^{d_w}$ indicates an input word vector and $\tilde{\mathbf {h}}_t$ , $\tilde{\mathbf {c}}_t \in \mathbb {R}^{d_h}$ represent the hidden and cell state of the LSTM at time $t$ ( $\tilde{\mathbf {h}}_{t-1}$ corresponds to the hidden state at time $t$ -1). $\mathbf {W}_\text{L}$ and $\mathbf {b}_\text{L} $ are learnable parameters. The remaining notation follows that of the tree-LSTM above.
